transcript.message: Hi, how do I reset my company password?
To reset your password, go to the IT Self-Service portal at portal.yourcompany.com and click 'Forgot Password'. You'll receive a reset link via your personal email on file.
What is the process to onboard a new vendor?

Vendor onboarding requires: 1) Submit a Vendor Request Form in Procurement portal, 2) Legal review (3-5 days), 3) Finance credit check, 4) Final approval from department head. Total process typically takes 2-3 weeks.
